title: GIMMICK: Globally Inclusive Multimodal Multitask Cultural Knowledge Benchmarking

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (using metrics like accuracy, ground-truth answer perplexity, and LLM-as-a-judge scores) on diverse multimodal question-answering tasks based on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage dataset across six global macro-regions to identify disparities and Western-centric performance gaps.
